question: Which of the following excretory products is stored in the old xylem of the plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Resin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Xylem** is a plant **vascular tissue** which carries water and dissolved minerals from the roots of the plants
 
• And also **provides physical support to the plant.**
 
• Xylem tissue **dies after one year** and then develops a new one.
 
• In plants, excretory products are stored in cellular vacuoles, in leaves that fall off, and in the old xylem as **resins and gums**.​
 
• The main functions of the resin are **to transfer stress between the reinforcing fibers, act as a glue to hold the fibers together, and protect the fibers from mechanical and environmental damage.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ Resin
 
 
• Resins can be produced through the bark of a tree.
 
• Resin are solid, semisolid ,water insoluble substance, Organic Substance.
 
• Resins are widely used in building as adhesives, coatings or as a construction material when a strong bond is required.
